# AlphaGraphics San Antonio — Shavano Park — FAQ Friday

> Straight answers on signage, vehicle graphics, print, trade shows, and promotional products for San Antonio business owners. Published weekly. Every claim is attributed to a named source.

AlphaGraphics San Antonio — Shavano Park · 16101 College Oak Drive, San Antonio, TX 78249 · (210) 222-0580
Areas served: Shavano Park, Castle Hills, Hollywood Park, Hill Country Village, Stone Oak, La Cantera, Leon Springs, The Dominion, Alamo Ranch, Helotes, Fair Oaks Ranch, Boerne, Fredericksburg, Kerrville, New Braunfels, Selma, Schertz, Blanco, and Buda.
Services: vehicle wraps, building signage, banner printing, trade show displays, business card printing, brochure and booklet printing, direct mail, EDDM, promotional products.

## Answers

- [Do QR codes on print actually get scanned?](https://dashing-cascaron-3d4d6f.netlify.app/faq-friday/do-qr-codes-get-scanned/): More than ever — when you give people a reason. Sources: TEAM LEWIS Research, 2024; GS1 Sunrise 2027.
- [Do branded promo products actually work?](https://dashing-cascaron-3d4d6f.netlify.app/faq-friday/do-promo-products-actually-work/): Yes — because people keep them, and remember you. Sources: 2026 ASI Global Advertising Impressions Study.
- [Can better print make your business look more valuable?](https://dashing-cascaron-3d4d6f.netlify.app/newsletters/Week05.html): Yes. Sources: Foil & Specialty Effects Association; Clemson Sonoco Institute / FSEA; Canada Post / TrueImpact; JICMail, Q4 2024.
- [Are trade shows worth the investment?](https://dashing-cascaron-3d4d6f.netlify.app/newsletters/Week04.html): Yes, because the room is full of people who can say yes. Sources: CEIR, Cost Effectiveness of Exhibition Participation; CEIR, The Spend Decision.
- [Does my brand have to look the same everywhere?](https://dashing-cascaron-3d4d6f.netlify.app/newsletters/Week03.html): Yes — and that consistency is worth up to 23% in revenue. Sources: Marq (Lucidpress) Brand Consistency Report; Edelman Trust Barometer.
- [Will a new sign actually bring in customers?](https://dashing-cascaron-3d4d6f.netlify.app/newsletters/Week02.html): Yes — your sign is the best-value salesperson you will ever hire. Sources: FedEx Office Signage Survey.
- [Does a wrapped vehicle pay for itself?](https://dashing-cascaron-3d4d6f.netlify.app/newsletters/Week01.html): Yes. Sources: OAAA / ARD outdoor advertising study; 3M vehicle-wrap study.
